scope: Accumulate successful HTTP response ranges per prepared export, preserve incomplete and active downloads, and reclaim completed segmented transfers when preparing the next export

before.sourceState: Final test file ran directly against unchanged b.4.0 production sources before the fix. Both production fingerprints match the release snapshot and Git baseline.
before.reproduction: Seven real HTTP cases reached the complete-download quota assertion and received 409 instead of 200; the ordinary partial/304/416/HEAD/full-retry compatibility case passed.

application.skipReason: Native archive interoperability and registry agreement require VIENTO_TEST_ARCHIVE_BINARY. b.4.0 native evidence retained; no native sources or archive formats changed.

commands.after: /usr/bin/node --test scripts/tests/export-downloads.test.mjs scripts/tests/export.test.mjs scripts/tests/export-cleanup.test.mjs scripts/tests/export-cancellation.test.mjs scripts/tests/export-streams.test.mjs scripts/tests/export-preparation.test.mjs scripts/tests/export-snapshot.test.mjs scripts/tests/export-bridge.test.mjs scripts/tests/editor-dialogs.test.mjs scripts/tests/doc-api.test.mjs

testEnvironment: Isolated real ZIP generation and loopback HTTP routes on synthetic projects. Selected real read is paused until the client disconnects; concurrent successful responses are held to control reader completion order. Reassembled bytes, independent ZIP decoding, every manifest digest, unchanged authored bytes and empty staging directories are checked.
limits: Only fully completed responses prove byte ranges; a disconnected response does not prove its already-sent prefix.
Completion is a server-side transfer condition, not confirmation of browser filesystem persistence.
At most 128 disjoint successful ranges are retained; excess fragmented evidence is conservatively discarded, never used to evict a pending job.

cleanup.verification: Fixture teardown awaits recursive deletion for all cases; each child verifies the export cache is empty after cleanup. Failed pre-fix fixture paths were additionally checked absent.
